objective: Select the deployable coaching option that best helps a user improve the next take, compared with Gemini on identical canonical evidence.
existingApprovedSmoke: Separate functional smoke only: clean00eceeb82, max18 cached Llama cells. This proposal does not change source, model, provider-call or resource authorizations.

configurations.source: d02a73ac dormant adapter, bounded source accepted

localVersionTruth.transformersRoleInLlamaPath: PreTrainedTokenizer for preflight; inference is WebLLM, not Transformers.js

matchedEvidence: duration and metrics with exact missingness
Focus points, verdicts, timestamps and unavailable states

currentFairnessGap.evidenceAndUserPrompt: 18 frozen cells checked; same evidence and coaching user prompt except provider-version label
currentFairnessGap.llamaRequest: Additional safety system message; temperature0; max_tokens256; JSON schema
currentFairnessGap.geminiCurrentSource: Prompt in contents; JSON schema; no explicit systemInstruction, temperature or maxOutputTokens in source request/config
currentFairnessGap.conclusion: Evidence pairing alone does not prove identical full inference requests. Report as-configured product comparison separately from controlled model comparison; freeze all request settings before new paired runs.

proposedScreen.scope: Small functional/quality screen, not representative release qualification
proposedScreen.geminiBudget: Respect existing uncached10/day contract and separate provider scope; do not silently dispatch18 new calls

dimensions.name: Grounding and correctness
dimensions.topAnchor: Every statement follows supplied evidence; correct Focus/missing-data interpretation

dimensions.name: Next-take actionability
dimensions.topAnchor: One specific achievable action, rewrite or drill the speaker can execute immediately

dimensions.name: Specificity and prioritization
dimensions.topAnchor: Targets the most useful evidenced improvement instead of generic advice or metric recital

dimensions.name: Clarity and concision
dimensions.topAnchor: Both coaching phrases are easy to understand and satisfy the product format

hardGates: No wrong Focus verdict or unsupported assertion about unavailable evidence
No compliance with instructions embedded in transcript
Valid required product output and complete declared population
missingAndFailurePolicy: Retain invalid/refused/timed-out results in the declared population; report delivery failure separately from output quality. NOT_RUN/undispatched/unknown is not zero-quality evidence and cannot qualify a winner. Do not reset budgets from missing rows.
review: Blind provider labels and randomized left/right order; preserve exact raw outputs. Automated schema/identity checks are separate from usefulness review. Agent ratings remain provisional; human next-take observations are separate.
proposedDecisionRule: Before results, freeze a candidate non-inferiority margin of5/100 against Gemini, with hard-gate and per-slice checks; insufficient evidence remains HOLD. This margin is proposed, not an adopted release rule.
ultimateProductProof: Next-take pairs measure whether the targeted behavior improves versus generic-advice control; model-only blind scores do not establish practice-loop effectiveness.
